anchors: a value no two paths agree on is not chosen
decision: A first-contact value every later step trusts (size, identity, Range support) comes from two independent paths that agree, never the first reply; disagreement asks further paths and a value no two agree on ends the run as a plain failure; the chosen value stays a working value a trusted check confirms.

evidence.text: Found in plan self-review of the net-rotating-proxies chunked fetch; GREEN opus and haiku kept the first reply provisional and asked a second path; the disagreement case was a GREEN gap, closed and re-probed.

reopen_if: A trusted channel to the origin is available for the first contact, so no untrusted peer decides the value.
why: The first design of a chunked proxy fetch trusted the first probe reply, so one lying proxy could switch the mode, plant a wrong size, or plant an identity that got every honest proxy banned.

anchors: Never write a PERMANENT shared ban on an answer the ORIGIN could have produced
decision: Never write a permanent shared ban on an answer the origin could have produced (404, identity change, TLS certificate, CONNECT refused with a status); evict for the run, and ban only a peer whose own TCP connection was refused, failed or timed out.

evidence.text: net-rotating-proxies fetch: one ETag change banned 6 of 6 clean proxies, a CONNECT 502 banned 4 of 4. GREEN opus and haiku banned only the TCP-refusing peer; the status-refusal wording was a GREEN gap, closed.

reopen_if: The ban list becomes per-run, or bans expire fast enough that one origin event cannot empty the pool.
why: One origin event otherwise bans the whole pool for every later job.

anchors: disagreeing with the RECORD, however many peers outvote it
decision: Peers agreeing never builds a hard stop or a refusal of saved progress; agreement only evicts peers that disagree, a resumed job trusts its own verified record over a fresh vote, and a real remote change ends as a plain failure when the trusted check fails.

evidence.text: net-rotating-proxies fetch: agreeing liars stopped healthy runs with exit 2 in 3 of 3 runs before the category was removed; on re-review two page-injecting proxies decided the rerun vote and refused a valid manifest. GREEN opus and haiku resumed on the record and evicted the outvoting peers; re-probe confirmed.

reopen_if: Peers can be authenticated, so agreement among them is evidence about the origin.
why: Peers that lie alike fake agreement, and tightening the agreement rule only moved the hole: two, then three agreeing liars stopped healthy runs, and a rerun probe vote refused a valid manifest with delete-it advice for an unchanged file.
